Our work

Our mission is bigger than any one program or cause.

Raising the next generation

We encourage young people to lead by example, put others first, work hard for what they believe in, and make a difference in the lives around them.

  • Scholarships
  • Youth athletics
  • Mentorship
  • Community outreach and charitable initiatives

Standing with families facing cancer

We support young adults battling leukemia and other bone marrow cancers, and the families facing unimaginable challenges alongside them.

  • Support for young adult patients
  • Help for families
  • Advocacy for better cancer care

Chris’s vision for safer care

People in cancer treatment often have weakened immune systems, yet they walk through the same emergency room doors as everyone else. Chris envisioned safer, dedicated emergency room entrances for cancer patients.

It’s one of the ideas Chris had for making the world a little better. We’re carrying it forward and working to make it real.

The Chris Strong Scholarship

Honoring a graduating senior baseball or softball player at Lake Mary High School who shows character, integrity, quiet leadership, and commitment on and off the field.

$1,000Awarded to one graduating senior

This is not a performance-based award. It is a character-based recognition.

Who can apply

  • Graduating senior on the Lake Mary High School baseball or softball team
  • Continuing to a college, university, or trade school
  • Minimum 3.0 GPA

The essay

Write 500 to 1,000 words in response to:

“What does ‘Do Better. Be Better.’ mean to you, and how will you live it?”

How applications are reviewed

A five-person panel reviews every application. Grades are verified with admissions.

  • 40%EssayDepth, authenticity, vision
  • 30%Character and leadershipIntegrity, accountability, team impact
  • 20%AcademicsGPA and consistency
  • 10%Overall representationEmbodies Chris Strong values

How to apply

Complete the application form (name, contact information, GPA, sport, intended school, and intended major or trade), sign it, and attach your essay.

Get the form from your Lake Mary High School baseball or softball coach, or by contacting the foundation.

Where to submit

  • Email it to the foundation
  • Or hand it to your Lake Mary High School baseball or softball coach

Deadline: May 18, 2026

This is not about stats. It’s about who you are when no one is watching.

Be steady. Be strong. Be selfless.

Who Chris was

Chris was the kind of player, and person, who didn’t need recognition to do the right thing. He led quietly, through his actions.

He loved baseball, and he loved being out on the water. He stayed after practice to help teammates, encouraged others, and made sure no one was left behind. He made sure the field was ready, not just for himself but for everyone who stepped onto it.

Chris was inducted into the National Honor Society and embodied excellence in both academics and athletics. That’s who he was. Not just in baseball, but in life.

  • Hard work
  • Integrity
  • Compassion
  • Selflessness
  • Actions over words

3:00 a.m.The night the sprinklers broke

One night, when the field’s sprinkler system broke, Chris stayed until 3:00 in the morning to fix it.

No one asked. No spotlight. Just a quiet decision to step up.

Carry it forward

Chris set an example through the way he lived. Anyone can carry it forward, wherever they are.

  • Parents

    Encourage your children to work hard, be good teammates, and help others.

  • Coaches

    Notice the player who stays behind to clean up, encourages a struggling teammate, or steps up when something needs doing, without expecting recognition.

  • Young people

    Your character matters more than the trophies you collect.

  • Everyone

    The smallest act of kindness can change someone’s day, or their life.

  • Families facing cancer

    People care, and we’re working toward meaningful improvements in your experience.
